name: Schengen short-stay visa (Category C)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave the Schengen area at the end of your visit.
This requires showing sufficient funds for the visit and return journey.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds and intent to leave

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: valid throughout the Schengen area, not just France; cannot be used to establish residence

notes: Same €90 base fee as every other Schengen visitor route in this dataset (Germany, Portugal, Spain), all implementing the same EU Visa Code — the sixth confirmation of this figure across the dataset, a genuinely reliable cross-check. ETIAS status treated the same as flagged on Portugal's and Spain's equivalent routes: expected but not yet confirmed in force at this verification date.
